coverage_note: The derangement definition and the complete enumeration of all 3! = 6 permutations of ABC (only BCA and CAB survive) were readable. The general formula, onto-function counting and the totient application were past the cut.
concepts: A derangement is a permutation with no fixed point - one element staying home disqualifies it.
For three elements: 6 permutations, 2 derangements (BCA, CAB), so !3 = 2.
Subtracting fixed-point cases is an inclusion-exclusion computation, not a single subtraction.
